# Security Checklist: Garage Object Storage

**Purpose**: Formal release-gate review of the security and secret-handling requirements for the Garage deployment change, the provider-neutral migration command, and the operator documentation.
**Created**: 2026-11-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [X] CHK001 Are the credential sources for both stores (destination `AWS_*` and source `SCOUT_MIGRATE_SOURCE_*`) explicitly enumerated with required/optional status? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-014]
- [X] CHK002 Are secret-handling requirements specified for logs, error messages, and summaries at both startup and migration? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-014, Constitution §Security]
- [X] CHK003 Are Garage administrative credentials (`rpc_secret`, admin token) covered by a requirement, including whether development defaults must be replaced? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [X] CHK004 Are network-exposure requirements defined for the Garage S3 and admin ports? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, Contracts §garage-deployment]
- [X] CHK005 Is the trust boundary between a local development stack and an externally reachable deployment stated for plain HTTP? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [X] CHK006 Is "never logged" scoped to the specific artifacts it covers (application logs, error text, audit log, migration summary)? [Clarity, Constitution §Security]
- [X] CHK007 Is the required least privilege for the source-store credential quantified (read-only versus read/write)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008, §FR-014]
- [X] CHK008 Is "explicitly named source configuration" precise enough to prevent accidental reuse of destination credentials? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [X] CHK009 Is redaction specified for endpoints that may embed credentials or signed query strings? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [X] CHK010 Do the startup-probe failure messages and migration error messages share one non-disclosure rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-014, §SC-005]
- [X] CHK011 Are the feature's secret-handling requirements consistent with the constitution's security constraints? [Consistency, Constitution §Security, Spec §FR-014]
- [X] CHK012 Is provider neutrality consistent with security guidance, with no provider-specific credential assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §FR-014]
- [X] CHK013 Do the compose stack and README agree on which credentials are operator-supplied versus development defaults? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Contracts §garage-deployment]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [X] CHK014 Can "secrets never appear in error text or logs" be objectively checked from observable output? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, §FR-014]
- [X] CHK015 Is there a measurable criterion for rejecting or warning about development default secrets outside a local stack? [Gap, Measurability]
- [X] CHK016 Is the admin API's local-only exposure stated as a testable acceptance criterion? [Gap, Measurability, Contracts §garage-deployment]

## Scenario Coverage

- [X] CHK017 Are requirements defined for credential misconfiguration at startup (wrong key, missing key, insufficient permission)? [Coverage, Spec §US3, §FR-005]
- [X] CHK018 Are requirements defined for a partially authorized bucket (read but not write or delete)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, §Edge Cases]
- [X] CHK019 Are requirements defined for migrating with a source credential that unexpectedly has write permission? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [X] CHK020 Are requirements defined for rotating or replacing credentials after cutover? [Coverage, Gap]
- [X] CHK021 Are requirements defined for a leaked migration source secret (abort guidance and rotation)? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-014]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [X] CHK022 Is behaviour defined when an endpoint URL contains embedded credentials? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [X] CHK023 Is behaviour defined when logging is set to debug or trace and includes request details? [Edge Case, Gap, Constitution §Security]
- [X] CHK024 Is behaviour defined when a storage failure could echo an authorization header or signed URL? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [X] CHK025 Is behaviour defined when a credential is empty or still a placeholder value? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-014]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [X] CHK026 Are confidentiality requirements specified for payload contents during migration (never printed, never written to logs)? [Non-Functional, Constitution §II, §Security]
- [X] CHK027 Are transport-security expectations (TLS versus plain HTTP) stated per environment? [Non-Functional, Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [X] CHK028 Are least-privilege requirements defined for the Garage bucket policy (read/write/delete scope)? [Non-Functional, Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [X] CHK029 Is auditability of migration actions specified (who ran it, when, counts) without exposing secrets? [Non-Functional, Gap, Constitution §Security]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [X] CHK030 Is the assumption that operators supply secrets through the environment documented and validated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-014]
- [X] CHK031 Is the assumption that Garage admin and RPC ports are not publicly exposed validated? [Assumption, Gap, Contracts §garage-deployment]
- [X] CHK032 Is the dependency on the deployment platform's secret storage (compose environment or orchestrator) documented? [Dependency, Gap, Spec §FR-014]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [X] CHK033 Does any requirement permit a default or example secret in a non-local deployment? [Ambiguity, Contracts §garage-deployment]
- [X] CHK034 Do the constitution's hashed-at-rest token rules interact with any new migration configuration or storage? [Consistency, Constitution §Security, Spec §FR-014]
- [X] CHK035 Is the constitution's "security-sensitive changes require explicit review" gate reflected in this feature's verification tasks? [Traceability, Constitution §Development Workflow]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
